title: Lifelong Learning of Hate Speech Classification on Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical machine learning approach (Variational Representation Learning and LB-SOINN) to improve lifelong learning in hate speech classification. While the categories of the dataset include religious groups (e.g., Anti-Muslim, Catholic, Anti-Semitism), the paper's objective is to solve the problem of catastrophic forgetting in neural networks rather than evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
